data.description: STALE: versioned_store.py was refactored (2025-12-31) and now delegates to CDGStore. Lock ordering in CDGStore is consistent: write_lock -> write_process_lock -> history_lock/version_locks. Original issue may have been fixed during migration. Needs verification that no other code paths violate lock ordering.
data.title: Fix potential deadlock in versioned_store lock acquisition
